parts.title: Ctrl+S reviews account, time, guests and Meet; y creates the event and emails both guests
parts.headline: Review, then send the invitations
parts.subtitle: Account, time, guests and Meet on one screen. Nothing is sent until you confirm.

parts.title: Roadmap review appears in the Week at 10:30; Enter opens details with the generated Meet link

parts.subtitle: Roadmap review · Tue 20 Oct · 10:30–11:15 UTC · guests Maya and Leo
